g.text: Train your own model, step by step
Asha, today you train a real language model yourself, on this computer, in about 2 minutes. It's built exactly like MONA, just
100× smaller. Choose a step and press Enter to run it. Go in order: 1 → 7.

Too small: every step is timid, so it learns slowly. Too big: steps
overshoot, the loss jumps around or gets stuck. Somewhere in between is best,
and finding it is a real part of every lab's work. MONA uses 6e-4, a value
known to work at this size (GPT-3's 125M-parameter model used it too).
